headline: Resident Evil is a comedy first and a thrilling nightmare second
summary: Paul W.S. Anderson's 2002 Resident Evil film challenged the perception of video game movies. It followed successful adaptations like Mortal Kombat despite earlier failures like Super Mario Bros. The film series is unexpectedly seen as comedic alongside its horror elements.

headline: Walmart takes a bite off the cost of Metroid Ravenous physical preorders
summary: Metroid Ravenous is a new 2D Metroid game for the Nintendo Switch 2. It marks a return to the series' 2D roots, similar to 2021's Metroid Dread. Walmart offers a $10 discount on physical preorders for the game.

headline: Apple might make servers again to cash in on the AI rush
summary: Apple is reportedly planning a return to the server market, potentially partnering with Nvidia. The company previously exited the server business after discontinuing its Xserve line in 2011. This move aims to capitalize on the increasing demand for compute power in the AI industry.

headline: Your ‘health age’ is fake
summary: This article is from 'Optimizer,' a newsletter by Verge senior reviewer Victoria Song. It critiques the concept of 'health age' often promoted by wearables and longevity products. The author expresses skepticism about claims that gadgets and potions can change one's life.

headline: RAVEN2 - ZERO Lets Players Enter an Apocalyptic MMORPG Where Growth Is Tied to Gameplay
summary: RAVEN2 - ZERO is a new apocalyptic MMORPG. Players can enter this online role-playing game. Character growth and progression are directly linked to gameplay actions.

headline: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Releases Single New Plane DLC That Costs $74.49
summary: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 has released a new 'superjumbo' Airbus A380 DLC. The single new plane is priced at $74.49. It's an exclusive, limited-time offering available for three months on PC, Xbox, and PS5.

headline: Studio Behind Hyper Light Drifter In Peril After Publisher Withdraws Funding for Unannounced Project
summary: Heart Machine, the studio behind Hyper Light Drifter, faces financial difficulties. A publisher unexpectedly withdrew funding for one of their unannounced projects. The studio's future is now uncertain due to this lost funding.

headline: Star Trek: The Next Generation - The Complete Series Is on Sale for $49
summary: The complete digital HD series of Star Trek: The Next Generation is currently on sale. It is available for purchase at Amazon for $49. This offer covers the entire run of the iconic sci-fi show.

headline: Body found in search for missing three-year-old Noah Woods
summary: Police divers discovered a child's body in a pond. The discovery was made during the search for three-year-old Noah Woods. Noah had been missing since Tuesday after disappearing from a playground.

headline: 'Grief can colour memory': Palace responds after Earl Spencer's claim in Diana book
summary: Earl Spencer made claims about the then-Prince of Wales in his new book on Princess Diana. He alleged a comment was made during an argument over Diana's funeral arrangements. Buckingham Palace responded, suggesting grief can affect memory.

headline: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
summary: The EU chief supports a proposal for Canada to gain 'associate member' status. Canada is pursuing stronger ties with the European Union. This follows a deterioration in relations with the US and President Donald Trump.

headline: 'Putney pusher' suspect found dead at home
summary: Nicholas Brandram, a suspect in the 'Putney pusher' incident, has been found dead. He was suspected of pushing a woman into a bus's path nine years ago. The incident occurred in Putney, causing a significant investigation.
